title: Idle's Timewarp
description: A small mod that introduces powerful time-altering mechanics to your world
body:
**Idle's Timewarp is a small mod that introduces powerful time-altering mechanics to your world.**

_Master the flow of time and reshape your survival experience!_


This mod adds:


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Warped Clock – A special clock that lets you speed up time for a short duration, at the cost of its durability.
- Time Shard – A rare and valuable shard, used to craft the Warped Clock and to Repair it.
- Time Core – The base core required to craft the Warped Clock, obtained by slaying Wardens within the Deep Dark.
- Time Sickness - A new negative side effect caused by using the warped clock.
- Commands to customize values of various features (op required).

</details>



You can use this mod in your modpack without any problems.
